evals.prompt: A creator asks: ‘Make every African cell, including Egypt, Soviet-controlled at the opening.’ The active Davia draft exposes cells.json with an existing scalar stat id named `superpower alignment`; -100 is valid, but one unrelated unchanged cell contains a legacy out-of-domain value. Explain the exact MCP workflow and where each part of the request belongs. Do not edit repository product files.
evals.expected_output: A concrete workflow that reads the skill/current files, edits the relevant African cell values despite the spaced id and unrelated legacy value, updates opening context only if needed, avoids inventing a simulation rule, preserves identities, and verifies the final distribution.
expectations: Uses the exact existing stat id `superpower alignment` instead of renaming or slugifying it
Treats the unchanged legacy value as unrelated rather than a blocker or cleanup target
Places Soviet control in cell starting values and opening context, not in simulation rules
Uses list/select/read/grep/edit/reread and preserves read-only identities
Does not claim support for adding cells, changing geometry, or assigning assets
Does not require a prose edit when the existing opening context is already consistent

evals.prompt: A creator asks: ‘Add John Doe to my game in San Francisco, California. Use cell_id 258, longitude -122.4194, and latitude 37.7749.’ Explain the exact MCP workflow and the complete entity shape you would add. Assume no equivalent actor exists after checking. Do not edit repository product files.
evals.expected_output: A workflow that searches entities and landmarks for duplicates, reads the latest entities.json, appends a complete John Doe object with a placeholder slug and the exact supplied placement, rereads the file for the canonical slug, and does not replace the coordinates with the cell center.
expectations: Checks current entities and landmarks for an equivalent John Doe before creation
Appends a complete entity object instead of claiming creation is unsupported
Uses cell_id 258 with longitude -122.4194 and latitude 37.7749 exactly
Uses a name-derived placeholder slug and rereads entities.json for the canonical slug
Does not substitute a cell centroid or generic California coordinate
Recognizes that a new entity may start either on-map or off-map
